items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: There was a John Tonkin there. Had a 14-piece band. We went over there, and the fella gave us the hall to play.

ctx.x: He was from Morgan City. He used to be around there. He left them here and went to Alexander. I went to play with him in Alexander, but I stayed over there four years. And then people don't pay nothing. Only go from state to state. Make 15 cents. Time is bad over there then. You can ride on a free train for nothing. Go anywhere for nothing, you know, looking for weight. Sometimes we go to Texas. A great big white brother, about six feet tall, a little over, and great big hats on. They come to me. They wouldn't…
Ask him about Joe Harris, Winston.
